construction: as predictions.json P0.3: per row, the seed-0 fine-tune's delta-W (E18: E38's cached s0; E12: results/large/<task>_s0.pt; the same files and sha256 as stage 0b), finetune.random_direction(dW, seed 0), times c in (0, 100] found by perturb.match (12-point log grid 0.01 .. 100, then 40 halvings inside the first grid interval that reaches the target) so the full model's kl_other equals kl_target within kl_rel_tol (10%). kl_target = stage0b.json states['<task>/s0'].kl_other, the value stage 0b matched to. Read by run.cells with released components (a do-nothing state), as stage 0b

control.rule: runs first on each task, before its row: kl_other of the random direction at the scale stage 0b settled on (stage0b.json states['<task>/random'].scale: 10, or 6.5025 on rand32b) within repro_rel_tol (2%) of that row's recorded kl_other. A miss stops the job (exit 1) before the task's row
control.source: repro_rel_tol is E38's t1_rel_tol (2%), the reproduction tolerance stage 0a used; stage 0a reproduced every cached state's T1 exactly, so the expected miss is 0 on the same card
control.expected: kl_other equal to stage 0b's to about 1e-6 (same code path, windows, direction and card type)

P0.3.rule: unchanged from predictions.json: within_floor = |g| <= F; fails = |g| > F AND |g| >= 0.25 x |g of that task's seed-0 fine-tune| (stage0b.json states['<task>/s0'].g)
P0.3.verdict: unchanged, computed by run.score on stage0b.json's table with the seven random rows replaced by this run's: fail if any random row fails or the non-positive rule fails (every row with G <= 0, the new random rows included, reads g <= 0.1 + F); else pass if every random row is within_floor; else inconclusive
P0.3.cap: a row whose kl_other at c = 100 is below 0.9 x kl_target is 'cap' and is scored at c = 100 (as filed); 'no_match' (40 halvings never inside 10%) is scored at the last midpoint, flagged in the row (as filed)
P0.3.expected: pass on the E18 and ident rows (|g| <= 0.1 there at c = 10, and Gamma follows the small real change a random delta-W makes); rand32 may read inconclusive. Matching needs c about 11 (emoticon) to about 29 (rand32) where kl_other grows as c^2

unscored.G_and_g_over_G: per row G = T1 - T0 and g / G, reported only when |G| >= g_over_G_min_abs_G (0.1 = F_min): a G within 0.1 nats of 0 gives a ratio of noise, so null. Stage 0b's rows read g about G
unscored.c: the matched scale c and kl_other per row, with the grid and bisection trace

order: P0.2 not pass -> 'stop: fix regeneration' (P0.2 reads unchanged rows: pass in stage 0b)
P0.3 fail -> 'card: P0.3 fail' (the reading goes to the user before any retire card: g tracking a real G is what Amendment 1 item 3 said should not retire a working stand-in)
P0.4 fail -> 'retire' (unchanged rows: pass in stage 0b)
any random row 'cap' at c = 100 -> 'card: cap' (whether to read P0.3 on the matched rows alone is the user's call)
P0.3 pass and P0.4 pass -> 'propose stage 1' (to the user; it still needs their go)
tree.note: first match wins; every combination of P0.2, P0.3, P0.4 status and any/no cap row lands in exactly one branch

edge_cases: a row still capped at c = 100: scored at c = 100 by the P0.3 rule (it can pass, be inconclusive or fail on |g|), and the tree goes to 'card: cap' unless P0.3 fails or P0.2 does not pass
g / G with G near 0 (stage 0b's r2_t359_v816 row read G = -0.008): |G| < 0.1 gives null, never a division by a near-zero G; unscored either way
the fail bar uses |g_ft| (the seed-0 fine-tunes' g are 3.6-11.6, all > 0), as filed
kl_target > 0 for every row (0.055-0.70 in stage 0b); perturb.match asserts it

a non-finite g or G (not expected: kl_other about 100 x stage 0b's at c = 100 is still a few nats) compares False on both within_floor and fails, so P0.3 reads inconclusive unless another row fails; such rows are listed in score.nonfinite
a random row with G <= 0 enters the non-positive rule (as filed), so a negative G with g > 0.1 + F fails P0.3
blind_to: a non-random direction of the same size; one random seed per task (as filed)
not_run: every other stage 0b row (read unchanged from stage0b.json); a second random seed; P0.4's write rows matched on kl_other (Fable's card note)
